name: HIWF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Crowned in the steel-cage final of the fed's own World Title Tournament, both men going off the top of the cage through three tables, awarded to "Mr. Universe" Tommy Drummond on the technicality that his feet touched the floor first; still on his chest as of the fed's own last-attested card, and later carried by him, unclaimed by any HIWF authority, into a promo staged inside a different federation entirely.

name: HIWF World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Crowned in a Tag Team Title Death Match won by the L.A. Mafia over the Hate Machine on a last-second pinfall at 59:59 of a sixty-minute limit; lost by the Mafia to the Nobles, also over the Hate Machine's own return challenge, within a month.
